caption: The video captures a male mandarin duck perched on a mossy stone beside a flowing stream. Its body is angled away, head turned back over its own flank. The bird is already mid-preening, bill tucked into the upper wing and back feathers. As the clip runs, the head lifts and rotates, the reddish bill working along the shoulder before tucking back down. Brief motion-blurred turns flare the blue-green crest, and the upright orange sail feathers shift their angle as the torso twists. Behind the bird, the stream shows continuous ripples and shifting bright reflections against blurred mossy banks. The duck's feet stay planted on the stone while its head, neck and torso work through the plumage.
